scope: Actual driving executor before pass/queue consent
finding: Owner consent checked local crew and authored route but not actual ordinary driving executor lifetime. QueueProposalCurrent compared a stored generation but an ended noncancelled FSM could still leave that map/public generation intact. Such an owner could promise participation without a callback able to apply a hold.
change: Shared DrivingPassCanConsent now requires exact current group/epoch/generation/route, noncancelled/nonfinished brain, and a typed finite nonnegative current live FSM. Both PASS and QUEUE callers inherit this observation. No startup, restart, timer, claim, native command or cleanup is performed by admission.
callTiming: Consent runs from existing driving callbacks or later owner protocol delivery, not FSM initialization. The driving handle is published by DrivingOperationStart before queued callbacks. A participant not yet adopted must wait for existing discovery rather than manufacture a controller from consent.

validation.package: Full local pipeline and independent verification passed; precommit dirty-source artifact, not later clean commit.

remaining: No moving queue context, leaf reverse or parent clearance implemented. Automatic queue initiation stays disabled.
